title: A New Course
sentences: I live in a little old house down by the river.
Some days the power is off, but it is my own.
This fall I started a course at the school.
On the first day, I asked a man at the station where it was.
He pointed to it on the map, between the farm and the factory.
I went through the field, and there it was.
In the course, we talk about the news.
The people in the course come from a number of places, such as the city.
Both of the people I study with help me with the words I do not know.
Today the mayor came to meet us.
Before I leave, I put my new words on a list.
I think it is a great place to live.
